segments.name: Mobile digital games
segments.description: Develops, publishes and operates mobile digital games for players across global third-party digital storefronts.
segments.evidence: Operated in Hong Kong, we are a comprehensive technology enterprise engaged in the development, publishing and operating of mobile digital games via various third-party digital storefronts.

changes.text: In 2025, the company disposed of Turing, its mainland China operating subsidiary, to an unaffiliated third party.
changes.evidence: After the Disposition, Turing is no longer owned by Quantum, and we have no operating subsidiary in mainland China.
